Interface ReactiveFluentFindOperation.FindWithQuery<T>

Type Parameters:
T - 返回类型
All Superinterfaces:
ReactiveFluentFindOperation.TerminatingFindWithoutQuery<T>
All Known Subinterfaces:
ReactiveFluentFindOperation.ExecutableFind<T>, ReactiveFluentFindOperation.FindWithProjection<T>
Enclosing interface:
ReactiveFluentFindOperation
public static interface ReactiveFluentFindOperation.FindWithQuery<T> extends ReactiveFluentFindOperation.TerminatingFindWithoutQuery<T>
终止调用实际查询执行的操作。
Since:
6.1
Author:
迈克尔·西蒙斯
